outcome: Preference for mode of birth after cesarean section
Factors influencing preference for VBAC or elective repeat cesarean section
cohort: 733 pregnant Polish women who had previously undergone a cesarean birth
finding: Women with a previous cesarean section more often preferred vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC) and their preferences were influenced by their obstetric history, personal beliefs, and perceptions of benefits, opportunities, and risks associated with each mode of birth.
mod_finding: Women with a previous cesarean section more often preferred vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC) than elective cesarean section.
